title: Send failures
description: ThinkZap outbound queue messages that did not reach the contact. Reprocessing puts the message back in the queue, under the normal sending rules (daily limit and cadence).
confirmDescription: The messages go back to the line queue and are sent under the normal rules. Check the date: an old message may arrive out of the conversation's context.
unknownWarning: {{count}} message(s) have an undetermined result: they may have been delivered already. If you reprocess, the contact may receive them twice.
unknownAcknowledge: I understand the risk and want to reprocess anyway

result.requeued: Message put back in the queue.
result.conflict: The message is no longer failed (already resent or being sent).
result.needs-confirmation: Confirm the duplicate risk to reprocess.
result.schedule-failed: Could not schedule the reprocessing. Try again.

batchSummary: {{requeued}} put back in the queue, {{refused}} refused.
emptyDescription: There are no failed or undetermined messages for the chosen filters.
errorDescription: Check your connection and try again. Periods longer than 90 days are not accepted.
